content.overview: Section 16 allows the deductions from salary income, including the standard deduction.
content.glance: Section 16 allows the deductions from salary income, including the standard deduction.
content.study: From salary income, the deductions specified in section 16 are allowed, including the standard deduction. No other deduction is allowed under this head except as the section provides.
